All coordinates came directly from embedded JSON-LD/map-center JS (Q-Park, APCOA, Contipark, B+B) or from Nominatim (WSW's 3 unique locations only - single synchronous curl+sleep loop, no rate-limit issues). Surprising finding: Wuppertal's Q-Park and APCOA presence is nearly negligible (1 garage each) compared to every other German city studied so far, while the municipal WSW and regional Contipark dominate the CBD/Hauptbahnhof area.
